name: Compare inventory snapshots and build a safe update CSV

parameters.content:
## Inventory update plan
A complete snapshot comparison, with no store writes.

Replace Example snapshots with complete normalized warehouse and catalog snapshots. Approve exact SKUs, set safety stock and a maximum change.

Duplicate SKUs, invalid quantities and incomplete snapshots stop the run. Missing, untracked and unapproved products go to review.

Output includes a CSV plan, review queue and counts. Run synthetic examples first. See the matching Markdown guide.
